channel.title: Clicked — English
channel.description: Free learning paths to understand the skills that matter next.
channel.itunes:author: Clicked

item.title: Learning how to learn — Make Your Study Time Actually Stick
item.description: Studying longer is not the answer: review early, test yourself instead of rereading, mix your exercises, protect your sleep and build a routine that survives bad days. The Learning how to learn path in one minute thirty-seven.

item.title: Data & Analytics — Stop Being Fooled by Bad Numbers
item.description: No advanced maths needed: tell a useful figure from a decorative one, break averages down, beware of false causes and of results you check too early. The Data & Analytics path in one minute forty.

item.title: ⏱ Productivity & Organisation — Stop Paying the Mental Transition Fee
item.description: Productivity is not about working faster: get tasks out of your head, protect your attention from interruptions, and rely on energy and systems rather than willpower. The Productivity & Organisation path in one minute forty.

item.title: Cybersecurity — Replace Digital Vigilance with Permanent Habits
item.description: No need to be a technical genius: stop reusing passwords, spot the pressure behind a scam, unplug your backups and check the blind spots. The Cybersecurity path in one minute thirty-nine.

item.title: Entrepreneurship — Get Your First Ten Paying Customers
item.description: Forget the startup fantasy: check that people want it, find your first customers by hand, watch your cash, and only speed up once the engine works. The Entrepreneurship path in one minute thirty-five.

item.title: Digital Marketing — Own Your Audience and Fix Your Funnel
item.description: Digital marketing is not a money pit but a system you can measure: own your contacts, fix the biggest leak before buying traffic, and keep the customers you have. The Digital Marketing path in one minute twenty-seven.

item.title: Web Development — Foundations That Last, and Technical Debt
item.description: The tools change every year, the foundations have not changed in twenty: how a page is built, how it becomes an application, and what makes a site last. The Web Development path in one minute thirty-five.

item.title: Finance — Protect Your Wealth from Fees and Panic
item.description: No maths degree and no inheritance needed: a safety net first, a plan built on your timeline, low fees, and a cool head. The Finance path in one minute forty-four.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence — Prediction, Memory and Security
item.description: A language model is not a database of facts but a prediction engine: what that changes for trusting it, building agents with it, and keeping it safe. The Artificial Intelligence path in one minute thirty-three.
